records.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code iterates `usernames.split(",")` without trimming each token. A payload like `"user1, user2"` will yield a second token `" user2"`, and `User.find_by_username(" user2")` will not match, silently skipping that member (no error/feedback).
